items.item: Sources/IO Kernel Events/Event.Actor.swift — `deregister(_:)` ends pending waits with `.left(.
items.reason: When a wait's channel closes, `wait` now throws .right(.deregistered) if the actor is still running and .left(.shutdown) otherwise (shutdown sets state before closing its senders). Test: `deregister ends a pending wait with deregistered` in IO.Event.Actor.Lifecycle Tests. README updated.

awaitEvent now throws the submit error, and submit<R> throws .kernel(error). If the .cancel(target:) submission is rejected, CancelCoordinator records the error, and a call that would have thrown .cancelled throws .kernel(error) instead. The test fake gained failNextSubmit(with:). Test: `rejected submission throws the kernel error`. README updated. Not tested: a rejected cancel submission (the fake can't target the second submission specifically without racing the cancellation).

api_changes: Behaviour: Event.Actor.wait(for:interest:) throws .right(.deregistered) (not .left(.shutdown)) when deregister(_:) ends it.
Behaviour: Completion.Actor.submit(_:descriptor:mapEvent:) throws .kernel(Kernel.Completion.Error) (not .cancelled) when the kernel rejects the submission or its cancel.
